The controller SHALL adjust a running guest's memory only between its declared floor and ceiling, clamping requests above the ceiling.
It SHALL refuse any target below the working-set floor or provider-reported non-balloonable memory.
It SHALL align targets to the provider's memory block size without leaving the declared bounds.
It SHALL record the hypervisor-confirmed applied value, never the requested value, and report refused/partial reclaim.
vCPU targets SHALL lie in [max(1, min_boot_vcpus), vcpu_max].
A partially applied vCPU change SHALL be compensated to the original count or reported as unknown.
A revert SHALL be accepted only for an authenticated audit record of this host/guest, in the current ownership epoch, whose applied value equals current live state.
On start-up every incomplete journalled operation SHALL be reconciled against live state before writes; mutations SHALL never be replayed blindly.
Σ guest memory SHALL NOT exceed usable host memory minus the reserve, including concurrently in-flight growth.
No guest SHALL be below its floor as a result of any INV-32 action, including recovery.

Cloud/datacenter: supported with a consensus lease store (BLOCKED ADR-0003). Near-edge: supported single-node with `FileLeaseStore`. Far-edge/disconnected: supported in local-safe mode only while lease and state integrity are provable; otherwise FROZEN_WRITE. Excluded: cross-site guest control.
rows.blocker: Consensus lease store (etcd/ZooKeeper/Consul) not selected (ADR-0003)

rows.text: Controller-owned decision p99 ≤ 2 ms; durable mutation p99 ≤ 50 ms on reference hardware (bench gate).
Read/health availability 99.9%; mutation availability is subordinate to safety (may freeze).
No acknowledged mutation SHALL lack a durable journal+audit record (fsync before response).
Linearizable per guest (serialized, CAS on provider state version).
Tenant-scoped principals SHALL NOT read or mutate other tenants' guests nor learn their existence.
Given identical inputs and seeds, decisions SHALL be identical (pure `_plan`).
RPO ≤ anchor interval (default 300 s); RTO ≤ 15 min (RUNBOOKS).
Every response SHALL carry one outcome ∈ {success, partial_success, degraded_success, rejected, retryable_failure, terminal_failure, unknown_outcome, rolled_back} and, on failure, a stable code.
Operation lifecycle: prepared → provider_requested → provider_confirmed → state_committed → audit_committed; side exits failed / unknown → reconciled. No other transitions.
Guest lifecycle: mutations only in `running`.
Tenant memory SHALL NOT exceed its hard cap; borrowing above guarantee SHALL NOT make another tenant's guarantee unsatisfiable.
Per-tenant rate and in-flight limits SHALL bound control-plane use; safety operations keep reserved capacity.

Loss of lease store → FROZEN_WRITE; loss of provider → circuit open, mutations rejected retryably; loss of telemetry → control continues (TELEMETRY_DOWN); loss of audit export → local durable audit continues, anchors queue.
Conflicts resolve: security/integrity > isolation/residency > state correctness > SLO/availability > cost/efficiency, unless governance approves otherwise via a waiver.

definition_of_done.text: Every fully missing control in Appendix A is implemented and has evidence.
Every partial control in Appendix B is closed or has a formally approved, unexpired waiver.
The real provider/hypervisor adapter passes the integration and compatibility matrix.
Authentication, authorization, ownership fencing, durable state, and audit persistence are active in the production path.
All mutation paths preserve host reserve, guest floor/ceiling, tenant authorization, idempotency, and stale-state fencing invariants.
Fault injection demonstrates deterministic recovery or safe halt for each documented failure mode.
Performance gates pass with reproducible p50/p95/p99/worst-case evidence on the approved hardware/software matrix.
Observability provides actionable health, metrics, logs, traces, decision explanations, dashboards, and alerts without secret/tenant leakage.
Day-0/day-1/day-2 and incident runbooks have been exercised successfully.
SBOM, signed provenance, compatibility matrix, RTM, benchmark evidence, security evidence, and test evidence are attached to the release.
Production exit gate returns machine-readable PASS with no expired waivers or unresolved P0 blockers.
